A '''planet''' in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] overthrew its tyrannical monarchy during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], and established a new government based on the Republic's principles with free elections.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Starting Fresh}}</ref>
